title: Month 1 — Foundations: Arrays, Hashing, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Prefix Sums
skillsExpected: Recognize basic linear patterns
Solve Easy in ~15–20 minutes
Solve common Medium in ~25–35 minutes
Master vector, string, unordered_map, sort
assessmentTarget: Two mixed Mediums in 70 minutes + 20-minute concept recall without notes
remedyAction: Keep the weakest two patterns in next week's review queue and reduce new learning until stable.

title: Month 2 — Linear Structures & Pointer Manipulation: Intervals, Stacks, Linked Lists, Binary Search
skillsExpected: Implement pointer/stack/search invariants without templates
Understand monotonic stack for nearest greater/smaller queries
Fast/slow pointer linked list transformations
assessmentTarget: Two Mediums in 70 minutes: one linked list and one binary search problem
remedyAction: Keep the weakest two patterns in next week's review queue and reduce new learning until stable.

title: Month 3 — Search Optimization & Dynamic Programming Foundations
skillsExpected: Define DP states and binary-search boundaries independently
Recognize 1D, knapsack, grid, and string DP state transitions
Implement binary search on answer space
assessmentTarget: Three mixed problems in 100 minutes (at least one must be a DP problem)
remedyAction: Keep the weakest two patterns in next week's review queue and reduce new learning until stable.

title: Month 4 — Recursion, Backtracking & Trees/BST
skillsExpected: Write recursion cleanly with proper base cases and backtracking cleanup
Distinguish DFS vs BFS vs BST invariants
Solve tree diameter, path sums, LCA, and serialization
assessmentTarget: Two Mediums + one selected Hard in 120 minutes
remedyAction: Keep the weakest two patterns in next week's review queue and reduce new learning until stable.

title: Month 5 — Advanced Structures & Graphs: Heaps, Tries, Graphs, DSU, Shortest Paths
skillsExpected: Model problems as graphs from verbal descriptions
Choose correct traversal (BFS vs DFS vs Dijkstra vs DSU vs Topo Sort)
Implement DSU and Trie from blank file
remedyAction: Keep the weakest two patterns in next week's review queue and reduce new learning until stable.

title: Month 6 — Advanced DP, Greedy & Blind Pattern Recognition
skillsExpected: Solve problems without being told the topic label
Recover from failed first approaches under time pressure
Master state-machine and interval DP
assessmentTarget: Two Mediums in 75 minutes + one Hard/Hard-variant in 45 minutes
remedyAction: Keep the weakest two patterns in next week's review queue and reduce new learning until stable.

title: Month 7 — Interview Simulation, OA Speed & Final Polish
skillsExpected: Communicate approach clearly, code, test, optimize, and handle follow-ups under pressure
Complete OA timed sets with 100% test case pass rate
Handle interviewer edge case challenges and modify code in-place
assessmentTarget: Full mock interview + timed OA set + final weak-area audit
remedyAction: Identify final 5 weak problems and perform blank-file re-implementations.
